name: Muse starter flow
description: Brief → character image → 10 s video, then chain a second shot from the first clip's last frame.

nodes.label: Brief
nodes.text: A young woman in a yellow raincoat runs across a rainy night street in Hanoi, neon reflections on the wet asphalt.

nodes.label: Hero still
nodes.prompt: Cinematic film still. @brief Medium shot, she stops under a shop awning and looks back over her shoulder. 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture.

nodes.label: Shot 1
nodes.prompt: Starting exactly from @hero: she catches her breath, then turns and keeps running down the street; the camera tracks beside her. Rain keeps falling, neon flickers. One continuous shot, no cuts.

nodes.label: Shot 2
nodes.prompt: Continue from @shot1_end: she reaches a tram stop, the tram doors open, she steps in and the doors close behind her. Same light, same rain. One continuous shot, no cuts.
